claims.evidence: No brand markings, country-of-origin text, or DOT codes are visible in any photo; origin cannot be confirmed remotely.
Tread wear is visible in Photos 1-2 but no depth gauge or measurement shown; wear pattern appears moderate, not clearly near-new.
Sidewalls and inner tread area not fully shown; yellow chalk marks could indicate shop markings or defect flags, not confirmed either way.
No DOT date code or manufacture stamp visible on any tire sidewall.

risks.risk: Actual tire size (width/profile/rim diameter) unknown, affects base value
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of sidewall showing size markings (e.g., 205/55R16)
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unspecified-size used tire, lowest common size assumption

risks.risk: Tire age (DOT code) could be much older than claimed 2023 removal
risks.proof: Close-up photo of DOT code on sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, worst case treated as older stock

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage, patches, or bulges not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Full 360-degree sidewall video of each tire

risks.risk: Number of tires and whether rims are included is unclear
risks.proof: Seller confirms exact count and itemizes tires vs rims separately with a clear photo of all pieces together
risks.if_unproven: priced as tires only, minimum quantity assumption (4 tires, no rims)

risks.risk: Tread depth claim (90%) unverified, could be lower reducing value
risks.proof: Photo of tread depth gauge or coin test on each tire
risks.if_unproven: priced as moderate wear, not near-new

proof_requests: Close-up photos of sidewall size markings on each tire
Close-up photo of DOT date code on each tire
Full sidewall video (360°) showing no patches, bulges, or cracks
Clear count and photo of all items included (tires and rims separately)
Photo showing tread depth measurement with a gauge or coin
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as used car tires, so a worst-case price is possible despite unverified seller claims about origin, age, and condition.
